title: Glowing trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8c0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0.22'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe97a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffc229'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e89a10'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldlight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd75e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='base' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe07a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c97f08'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M31 25 Q16 25 16 38 Q16 52 32 54' fill='none' stroke='url(#goldlight)' stroke-width='5.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M69 25 Q84 25 84 38 Q84 52 68 54' fill='none' stroke='url(#goldlight)' stroke-width='5.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cup bowl -->
  <path d='M30 22 L70 22 Q69 50 50 58 Q31 50 30 22 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <path d='M38 28 Q37 42 45 50' fill='none' stroke='#fff6c4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- shine star -->
  <path d='M50 30 L52.5 37 L59 38.5 L54 43 L55.5 50 L50 46 L44.5 50 L46 43 L41 38.5 L47.5 37 Z' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='45.5' y='57' width='9' height='11' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='58' width='3' height='9' fill='#fff0a8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- base -->
  <path d='M36 68 L64 68 L68 80 L32 80 Z' fill='url(#base)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='79' width='44' height='8' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='80.5' width='40' height='2.5' fill='#fff0a8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7c9'>
    <path d='M18 14 L19.5 19 L24 20.5 L19.5 22 L18 27 L16.5 22 L12 20.5 L16.5 19 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 16 L83 19.5 L86.5 20.5 L83 21.5 L82 25 L81 21.5 L77.5 20.5 L81 19.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 62 L87 65.5 L90.5 66.5 L87 67.5 L86 71 L85 67.5 L81.5 66.5 L85 65.5 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
